name: Motorcycle Simulator Kuwait
summary:
Ride Kuwait City from the seat - alone, or with up to three friends.

37 KM OF REAL KUWAIT CITY
The Arabian Gulf Street from Sharq round the Kuwait Towers, down the palm-lined coast past Green Island and Marina Mall to Ras Salmiya, then the Fifth Ring Road, King Fahd Road past the Liberation Tower and the First Ring Road round the old city.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
